info.title: Nuvyn CLI
info.description: Spec-driven CLI for building .NET MAUI apps on the Nuvyntra stack (MVVMExpress, Lumina UIKit, MauiEssentials plugins).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Nuvyn — spec-driven .NET MAUI apps on the Nuvyntra stack.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create a new Nuvyntra MAUI app and install the spec-driven agent workflow.

options.name: --agent
options.description: AI coding agent key (cursor, copilot, claude, gemini, codex, windsurf, …). Prompted when omitted.

options.name: --skip-host
options.description: Install workflow files only (no dotnet new). [default: False]

arguments.name: PROJECT_NAME
arguments.description: New project folder name. Always creates a new directory.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Refresh .nuvyn templates, reference, and agent skills. Does not overlay host code or specs/.

options.name: --agent
options.description: Refresh this agent's slash files (default: the agent recorded at init).

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check that dotnet, the Nuvyn payload, and (when inside a project) the host stack are available.
